Continue.description: Indicates to continue a previously failed build attempt

Help.description: Shows the help text for this build assembly

Skip.description: List of targets to be skipped. Empty list skips all dependencies

Target.description: List of targets to be invoked. Default is '{default_target}'

Verbosity.description: Logging verbosity during build execution. Default is 'Normal'

BuildProjectFile.description: Path to the build project (.csproj) relative to the repository root. Defaults to 'build/_build.csproj' when unset. Read by the Fallout global tool's in-tool runner.

BaseRef.description: PR base for Stryker --since; default origin/$GITHUB_BASE_REF, else origin/{ReleaseBranch}

NuGetFlatContainer.description: NuGet V3 flat-container base URL SetBaseline reads the latest Ducky GA from

Project.description: Mutation: mutate only this project (repeatable); default every active mutated project

ReleaseBranch.description: Branch releases come from; flipped to main by the GA rename PR (§21)

ReleaseVersion.description: Version (no v) of the release notes, the GitHub release and ShipPublicApi's analyzer release; default GITHUB_REF_NAME minus v, else MinVerVersion

Solution.description: Path to a solution file that is automatically loaded

StrictStages.description: For -rc.N and GA tags: every stage counts as active; Mutation mutates and checks all seven projects (§17.8), SpecTraceGate fails on any inactive entry and checks all 32 invariants (§19)
